Quick questions we hear in Coweta County

General guidance, your system may vary. When in doubt, we’d rather you call and ask than guess and dig.

How often should a tank be pumped?

For most households, every 3 to 5 years is the usual range, depending on tank size, household size, and garbage disposal use. If you don’t know when yours was last pumped, that’s reason enough to schedule a check, solids reaching the drainfield is where the expensive repairs start.

What are signs the drainfield is struggling?

Slow drains throughout the house, gurgling, sewage odor in the yard, unusually lush or soggy grass over the field, or backups after laundry day. One slow sink is plumbing. The whole house slowing down is septic until proven otherwise.

Do you do inspection letters for a home sale?

Yes, on-site inspection with the letter your lender or closing needs. Call the office at 770-253-4113 to schedule, especially if you have a closing date. Those letters are time-sensitive and we treat them that way.
